scope: Supplement to the frozen S8 protocol (s8-protocol-frozen.json is unchanged and keeps its verdicts). Long-interval rows for allocating workloads, where the frozen two-trip-count difference can bill one whole collection to the kernel when GC cadence shifts between builds (found 2026-11-02, s8-final-b28/string-rows-analysis.txt).

method.intervals: two paired_bench runs per row: short = (n1, n2), long = (n2, n4); BENCH_HIGH = n4 in both so warmups are identical
method.reported: kernel ns/step from the long interval (median of per-rep differences of inner_ns)
method.cadence_check: per engine, |median(short) - median(long)| / median(long); above cadence_tolerance the row is marked cadence_sensitive and its comparison is not to be quoted without the short value
